title: What Is an Aside? — English Literature Term
skills: define aside as a dramatic device
distinguish an aside from monologue and soliloquy
analyze how asides reveal information directly to the audience
explain how asides contribute to characterization, irony, and dramatic tension
alignment_note: Introduces the aside as a dramatic technique in which a character briefly addresses the audience while other characters are understood not to hear. Supports drama analysis, characterization, dramatic irony, audience awareness, and comparison with monologue and soliloquy across high school English courses.
